text: 43 tolde 23 and 36 in great earnest that discovering of
mindes and goodwilles to 93 wch was odious to 94. and some
soch, had vndone them all and truly 36 is of opinion that some soch
thing hath made 93 so mad as it appeareth wth 23. that he
will not heare him what ever 70 can doe, yet Feria promiseth vppon
94 and 95 retorne that some thing shalbe done.
40. 24. 23. 42. and some others have delt so long with one Captayn
White of Flushing that he is of late hanged for treason.
A marchant of ? for lodging one Captayn White and being suspected of
societye wth him is banished for 50. yeares all his goodes confiscate and
he come hither wth wife and children in miserye being a very riche man
before.
Mr Tipping wth his wife and children are come hither from St Omers. et
vadet habitatũ Mecliniam. Our regiment hath now no
Commaunder and being appoynted by the Count to lye in ? Clow
because they have no paye they ravage the Countrye at wch the Count
rageth and hath sent for the Coronell abowt it threatning to hange
the soldiors or to Cashe the Regiment.
Ligons is of opinion that 40. his make theyr vantage of
nothing so moch agaynst 20 as of 20 his frendes favor to

Vxor 73 pro certissimo est reconciliata sed id est valde secretum

Some advises are come that Mr Moore and Williamson were sent over of
purpose to doe mischefe. Eventus probabit nemini tamen puto eos posse
nocere.
